description: Pistes cyclables is a dataset listed in Open Data Val'Metro, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Valenciennes Métropole. Pistes cyclables actuellement en service sur Valenciennes Métropole. Coverage: Valenciennes Métropole. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements, Mobilité. Its keywords are Piste cyclable, Vélo, Déplacement, Mobilité, Transport. The portal shows 769 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-12-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-valenciennesmetro-portal.
